name: Unbounce
summary: Landing page builder for paid campaigns, with A/B testing and Smart Traffic routing each visitor to the best-converting variant.
best_for: PPC specialists and agencies running paid campaigns who want A/B testing and Smart Traffic (AI routing each visitor to the best-converting variant)
skip_if: your traffic or budget is small, or you want cheap unlimited pages — Landingi starts around $29/mo for similar basics
honest_knock: The entry price is high for a landing-page tool, and the visitor caps bite if a campaign takes off. It's also oddly behind on basics — no URL import, limited file/code management, and still no true AI page generation in 2026.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, or $22 billed yearly at 25% off
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-03 on their own pricing page, USD) Five published levels, monthly against yearly at 25% off: Starter $29 / $22, Build $99 / $74, Experiment $149 / $112, Optimize $249 / $187, plus Concierge custom pricing above that. The Starter tier is missing from most summaries, ours included until the August 2026 update, which described the range as beginning at $74. Pages are unlimited from Build up; Starter allows 5 pages and up to 500 visitors, 1 user and 1 root domain. Above Starter what pushes you up a tier is the visitor cap (20k on Build, 30k on Experiment, 50k on Optimize), so a traffic spike rather than a page count is what changes your bill. Every plan now lists an MCP server, and the 14-day trial still needs no credit card. Unlimited A/B testing starts at Experiment, and AI traffic optimization at Optimize.

exit_test.what: Built an unpublished AI landing page using the same two-section test prompt as the Pagecloud session.
exit_test.awkward: The prompt used a subset of the kit text, without its second lines or images. The Premium Free Trial grants access to the top plan. The page remains Unpublished; its code contains meta robots index,follow. This code value does not establish public accessibility or actual indexing. In the recorded Pagecloud session, the same prompt produced a page without the supplied headings and text; this compares those two outputs and is not a product ranking.

friction.reimport: Pasting code back into the editor was not tested.
friction.cancellation: Cancellation, expiry and account deletion were not tested. The control date, where recorded, is planning only.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 30 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We asked the AI builder for a one-page site with two sections of our test text, saved it unpublished and looked for a way to export the page.
findings: The account opened on a 'Premium Free Trial': 14 days on the top plan, with no card asked. A profile form (company, industry, size, experience) comes first.

The AI builder took our exact headings and text, accents and quotes included, and said so in its summary. It took about 30 seconds. We gave Pagecloud the same prompt the same day, and its AI builder left our text out.
The page stays unpublished until you click Publish, but its code already carries a 'robots: index, follow' tag.
We found no page export. 'Edit Code' shows the full HTML and CSS of the page, which you can copy out, but there is no download.
The trial counter in the app said '13 days left' on the signup day, with a traffic meter of 0/500 visitors.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
